title_suffix: structured (displacement-rank) boundary solves and radix-distributed sparse-union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
summary: Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below, b = certified endpoint - 1e-64, with two NEW constructions (not in PR1673 or PR1699): a radix-distributed sparse-union schedule (outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md) and structured boundary solves (outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md): the Gaussian blocks of a phase cell are D_r T D_c with T Toeplitz, so segment, coupling and pivot blocks of the boundary algebra have constant displacement rank and are applied by generator representations and FFT in O(r W log W) per right-hand-side column, tau_eff = 2 + 1e-64. The 55 strict inequalities, 9 rejecting controls (including the old union row and tau_eff at or below 2, which fail) and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation; three executable checks (union schedule, independent schedule simulation, exact displacement-rank/structured-solve check) are run; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; both new constructions need independent review; the precision argument of the structured solves is an error argument, not a verified theorem.
credits: PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski, with AI assistance): capped phase-cell fusion outer construction, its proof and exact evidence, vendored verbatim under vendor/pr1673. Gohberg and Semencul, Kailath, Kung and Morf, Bitmead and Anderson, Pan (structured Toeplitz-like matrix algorithms). Francois Le Gall, Alman, Duan, Vassilevska Williams, Xu, Xu, Zhou (rectangular exponents of the fallback packages), Chafik Boukhalfa (PR1699). The radix-distributed sparse-union schedule and the structured boundary solves are new in this package series; the independent schedule simulation outer/sched_review.py is by LeverRank. Supplier: PR1625 (mdumitrean) pivot-566 helper-donor kernel; PR1661 (midhatn) 400-digit endpoint-grid refinement of that stack; pivot-554 kernel (kernel566.py search by LeverRank/jeremykothe2 tooling, PR1672); PR1297, PR1319, PR1424, PR1485, PR1574 (Rohan Arun) T74 exact fill and cold kernels; PR1274, PR1479, PR1510, PR1513, PR1536, PR1578 (Jeremy Kothe) endpoint and outer-witness lineage; PR1534, PR1549 (midhatn); PR1519 (philippeVV) fine-Mercator soundness repair; PR1286, PR1193 (Jeremy Diviney), PR1148 (Thomas DiFiore) and the retained supplier lineage. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2. Implementation assistance: oh-my-pi.
